scripts.test:process: node src/cli.ts test run examples/apply-record/contract.md --command node --arg examples/apply-record/adapters/process-correct.ts

scripts.generate:unreal: node src/cli.ts generate unreal examples/apply-record/contract.md --profile examples/unreal/profiles/ue-5.8-editor.json --out-dir generated/unreal
scripts.generate:assets: node src/cli.ts generate assets examples/apply-record/contract.md --out-dir generated/assets
scripts.generate:evidence: node src/cli.ts generate evidence examples/apply-record/contract.md --out-dir examples/apply-record/evidence
